headline: Flyers place Owen Tippett on injured reserve
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Flyers have placed Owen Tippett on injured reserve, and the move opened the door for Philadelphia to call up Jacob Gaucher from AHL Lehigh Valley.

Tippett's numbers so far this season suggest the Flyers lose a player who was struggling alongside a team that is struggling more. He has one goal and one assist in nine games, and his own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his shots) come to 1.48, so he is only about half a goal short of what his chances warranted. The bigger issue is how the team played with him on the ice. At five-on-five, Philadelphia controlled just 32 percent of the expected goals with him out there, and the team's share was nearly five percentage points better when he sat. Last season he scored 28 goals in 81 games, so this is a clear dip, though nine games is a small sample. Gaucher has played one game this season and posted a 38 percent five-on-five share, which doesn't tell us much. The Flyers sit at 2-6-3 with a 40 percent expected goals share overall, and a goalie saving 3.7 goals more than expected is the only thing keeping them from looking worse.
